race.title: 2027 Group Package Deals Online Beginners Chase
race.verdict: REBEL REBA could only manage second when odds on for a maiden hurdle at Fairyhouse recently but a point win at the start of her career suggests she's worth another chance now chasing. Gavin Cromwell has won this 3 times since 2021 so his Naas handicap hurdle winner Let's Go Mans rates a possible danger. Walk In The Clouds has a profile which suggests she should take to chasing, while Kimy has placed in similar events this autumn. REBEL REBA (IRE) LET'S GO MANS (FR) WALK IN THE CLOUDS (IRE)
